meta.coverage_note: This index covers PF evidence disclosed on openCaselist, which is most of the national-circuit corpus from roughly the mid-2010s onward. It is not every card ever cut: teams that do not disclose are invisible to any tool, pre-openCaselist archives are out of scope, and disclosure is uneven across regions and seasons.
meta.source_note: Bulk history comes from the Yusuf5/OpenCaselist research dataset (MIT license) on Hugging Face; recent rounds come from openCaselist (opencaselist.com), which hosts the disclosures. Cards were cut and disclosed by the debaters credited in each citation; citations are reproduced exactly as disclosed and are never restamped.
